rationale.consistency: Reuses index.Options.Flags, IndexFilePaths and zoekt-git-index flag names, but gating Name in SetTemplatesFromOrigin globally alters zoekt-git-index (which presets Name) despite the keep-callers constraint; unix-only flock without build tag; main -h to stdout vs subcommand -h to stderr.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles root-as-repo, bare repos, cross-root duplicate names, missing index dir, no roots; but -incremental=false is ignored (IsRepoUpToDate short-circuits before IndexGitRepo), zoekt.name config breaks discovery/prune agreement, compound shards pruned wholesale.
rationale.scope: Adds exported IsRepoUpToDate plus a sizeable indexGitRepo refactor, remove also matches source paths, and the shared-indexer change is broader than an opt-in; otherwise on target.
rationale.readability: Clear file split and names; pruneShards shared; minor noise from redundant var err shadowing and 'Pass -f' printed even when nothing changes.
rationale.robustness: Lock acquired only after planning in sync (plan/lock race), IsRepoUpToDate errors swallowed, unreadable shards skipped silently, repo opened twice per index; closer cleanup on error paths handled; dry run never writes.
rationale.maintainability: Pointer-bag syncFlags and a throwaway flagset for main help; index flag duplicated across list/remove; name-preservation relies on implicit empty-Name coupling across packages rather than an explicit option.
